ห้องนั่งเล่นบ้านไทยโบราณ (Thai heritage-home living room): A formal living room seen frontally at standing eye level, lit by warm indoor lamps and recessed ceiling lights. Walls are dark reddish-brown teak panels; built-in glass-fronted wooden cabinets are on the left and right walls. Above, white louvered clerestory panels and a sloped white ceiling; a security camera at top right. Centre-top: two gilt-framed black-and-white portraits. Below them, a long wooden slab painted with a village scene hangs across the back wall. Back row, left to right: a cream sofa (partly visible), a green-and-gold striped sofa, an olive patterned sofa, a cream sofa, all with cushions. Two white-shaded table lamps: left on a small display cabinet holding white-and-blue plates, right on a lit glass cabinet with blue-and-white ceramics; beside each lamp is a vase (left cream, right blue). Centre: a rectangular ornate carved glass-topped coffee table (left) and a round red-and-gold glass-topped drum table (right). Foreground: two cream armchairs with carved dark wooden legs (left and centre), partial chairs at edges, and a dark wooden table edge at bottom. Small framed photos: two on left wall, four on right. Two dark patterned rugs on a wooden floor.
